tools.name: create_leaderboard
tools.description: Create a free RankFuel leaderboard (rnkfl.com) for radio listeners, no account needed: a public board for an on-air contest (call-ins, trivia, check-ins). Returns the public board URL, studio-screen URL and website embed (URL + iframe HTML), plus a SECRET manage token/URL in the "secret" block: give

tools.name: add_points
tools.description: Add (or with a negative number, remove) points for a listener on a RankFuel leaderboard. Needs the board id and its SECRET manage token. The listener is identified by public display name (+ optional town); a new name is added to the board automatically. PRIVACY: names are public, so use a first name

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Public standings of a RankFuel leaderboard (radio listener board): station, contest, open/closed, ranked listeners (display names, towns, points; ties share a rank), and a ready-to-quote answer with the leader. Use when someone asks "who is winning/leading …" and has an rfwin.uk/lb/<id> link. No tok

tools.name: close_leaderboard
tools.description: Close a RankFuel leaderboard when the contest ends: the public board shows final standings and no more points can be added. Pass reopen: true to reopen. Needs the SECRET manage token. Free, no key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_leaderboard" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "leaderboards" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_leaderboard · Private data: create_leaderboard, add_points, get_leaderboard, close_leaderboard · Public sink: create_leaderboard, get_leaderboard · Destructive: add_points.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_leaderboard · Private data: create_leaderboard, add_points, get_leaderboard, close_leaderboard · Public sink: create_leaderboard, get_leaderboard · Destructive: add_points

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
